summary: Enhance your IT governance knowledge with our comprehensive training course on COBIT, ISO 27001, and other frameworks. Elevate your skills today!
lede: IT governance training helps technology, service, security and audit professionals connect decision rights with service outcomes and information-security risk. Participants practise assessing COBIT governance objectives, mapping service value, reviewing ISO/IEC 27001:2022 controls, prioritising technology risks and building KPI dashboards for executive reporting. They use capability assessments, control crosswalks, risk registers and evidence plans to align governance decisions with operational work and communicate performance and remediation priorities.
audienceIntro: This IT governance frameworks training suits professionals who connect technology decisions with service delivery, information security, enterprise risk, audit, and executive accountability. It supports foundation-level learners who need a structured introduction and intermediate practitioners who want to integrate COBIT, ITIL, and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 in daily governance work.
modules: Integrated IT Risk and Control Assurance
IT Governance Roadmap and Executive Reporting
prerequisites: You need practical exposure to a technology, service-management, security, audit, risk, or compliance environment. Bring one non-confidential example of a technology risk, recurring service issue, control gap, or governance challenge for reflection exercises. Coding is not required. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted control monitoring and dashboard automation are covered at conceptual awareness and operational application levels, not technical engineering or production deployment level.
